# Akhilesh Kumar Bhagat

> Electronic Systems student at IIT Madras and Student Research Assistant at IIT Kanpur under India's National Quantum Mission. Works across embedded systems, HCI, assistive technology and robotics, with three patents (two granted) and research publications at CHI, UIST, NIME and Creativity & Cognition, plus a Best Paper Award at INDIS 2026. Builds human-centred hardware, from interactive musical interfaces to assistive devices and intelligent robots.

## Projects

### Musical interfaces

- **Layika — Tabla Glove** (Patent · NIME ’26) — Musicians count taal by tapping finger creases. This glove listens to those taps and plays real tabla sounds, so you can practise without an accompanist.
  - Conductive yarn on the finger creases detects taps; the microcontroller triggers MIDI tabla notes in real time.
  - ESP32 firmware on FreeRTOS samples the glove and sends hits over a low-latency ESP-NOW link.
  - Granted Indian patent No. 588076. Published at NIME 2026 as “Layika”.
  - I worked on the v1 design & engineering and the v2 redesign.
  - Tech: ESP32, ESP-NOW, FreeRTOS, MIDI
  - Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SofK-4aszQ4
  - Paper: https://scholar.google.com/citations?view_op=view_citation&hl=en&user=IMn1kfAAAAAJ&citation_for_view=IMn1kfAAAAAJ:qjMakFHDy7sC
- **Swarings** (Patent · UIST ’25) — Rings on a pipe make an instrument: touch a ring to play a note, slide it to bend pitch, rotate it for modulation.
  - Three gestures — touch, slide, rotate — give digital music the continuous control of an acoustic instrument.
  - Granted Indian patent No. 587794.
  - Published in the Adjunct Proceedings of ACM UIST 2025; played live in NIME concerts.
  - Tech: MIDI controller, Touch & rotation sensing
  - Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Udih5roTKNM
  - Paper: https://dl.acm.org/doi/abs/10.1145/3746058.3758455
- **GraviTone** (NIME ’25) — Coloured balls orbit a gravity well on a stretchy space-time fabric; an overhead camera tracks them and turns their motion into music and live visuals.
  - Balls launched from the rim orbit a central mass on the fabric; an overhead camera tracks each one (OpenCV).
  - Speed, position and orbit are mapped to synth parameters, VSTs and DAWs over OSC and MIDI.
  - Plays Indian classical ragas or Western scales, with real-time visuals that follow the balls.
  - Published at NIME 2025 and shown at India HCI 2025. I worked on the design and engineering, including the ball-tracking prototype.
  - Tech: OpenCV, Max/MSP, TouchDesigner, OSC / MIDI
  - Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZXFu8Hwz9fA
  - Paper: https://nime.org/proc/nime2025_95/index.html
  - Ball-tracking prototype: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dgAwJUS-uGE
- **Digital Theremin** (ESP8266) — Pitch from hand distance via capacitive sensing — no touch.
  - ESP8266 reads hand distance through capacitive sensing and maps it to pitch.
  - Tech: ESP8266, Capacitive sensing
  - Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bDaz183k65o

### HCI & Assistive

- **PathBuddy** (Best Paper · INDIS ’26) — People walk into things while looking at their phones. PathBuddy watches the path with a depth sensor and shows time-to-impact warnings on the screen they're already looking at.
  - External depth sensor + real-time on-screen overlays and time-to-impact estimates; no changes to the phone's hardware.
  - User study: more obstacles detected, lower cognitive load, better situational awareness.
  - First-author paper — Best Paper Award at INDIS 2026, IIT Guwahati.
  - Patent application 202511070920; listed for industry licensing by IIT Kanpur.
  - Tech: Depth sensing, Android, Computer vision
  - Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aQCHRbr6DfE
- **Mouth Tracker for XR** (CHI ’26) — Hands-free control for XR: this tracker reads tongue, cheek and jaw movement. Co-designed with artists who use it.
  - Custom hardware: ESP32-CAM firmware driving an IR camera, built on the open-source Babble project.
  - Streams camera data to the tracking software for hands-free control in XR.
  - Published at ACM CHI 2026: “When Assistive Technologies become Provocations”.
  - Tech: ESP32-CAM, IR camera, UART, XR
  - Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4WwQTNpG0hs
  - Paper: https://dl.acm.org/doi/abs/10.1145/3772318.3791535
- **Reading Indian Classical Dance** (C&C ’26) — A system that recognises a dancer's hand gestures (mudras) and expressions (rasa) and narrates their meaning, so new audiences can follow the story.
  - Extracts mudras, facial expressions and audio from a performance and produces text or spoken narration.
  - Study with 10 viewers using interviews and gaze tracking: audio narration kept eyes on the dancer, text overlays pulled them away.
  - Published at ACM Creativity & Cognition 2026.
  - Tech: Computer vision, Multimodal AI, Eye tracking, HCI
  - Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZX85xmg42VQ
  - Paper: https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3803784.3816837
- **Eye-Gaze Control for the ICU** (ESP32) — Lets people in intensive care choose options and call for help using just their eyes.
  - Eye-gaze interface with a tile menu; ESP32 drives the alert actuators.
  - Input validation avoids false triggers from natural blinking.
  - Tech: ESP32, Embedded C, Eye-gaze
  - Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZBW_Mjhi-4Q

### Robotics

- **Robo Rumble Teleop Bots** (MQTT) — Wi-Fi robots driven from a web page over MQTT; run live with 150+ users.
  - Web UI publishes forward / back / left / right / stop over MQTT (WebSocket) to a Mosquitto broker.
  - ESP8266 / ESP32 firmware subscribes to the robot's topic and drives the motors.
  - Run live at a robotics event with 150+ users.
  - Tech: ESP8266, MQTT, WebSocket
  - Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y03LePD6zvE
  - TeleOP_Bot: https://github.com/akhileshkrbhagat1/TeleOP_Bot
  - RobobumbleCC: https://github.com/akhileshkrbhagat1/RobobumbleCC
- **Mini Sphere Bot** (Gas sensing) — A small rolling robot with gas sensors for places people shouldn't go.
  - Gas-sensor interfacing, motor control and navigation in a compact spherical body.
  - Tech: ESP32, MQ sensors, Motor control
  - Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=owTTS3fFRSM
- **Shape-Following Robot** (Path planning) — Draw a path on a touchscreen; the robot drives it.
  - User-drawn contours become a sequence of drive commands, followed in real time.
  - Tech: Contour detection, JavaScript
  - Video: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/XuM-Vf0w7Zs
- **Robo Dominion Control Room** (Live event) — The live broadcast and control room for Robo Dominion, the robot battle run by Yantra at IIT Madras.
  - Public live page with camera feeds, scores, bot health and tower state, shown on the big screen.
  - Admin control room starts and pauses the match and talks to an ESP32 ESP-NOW master over Web Serial.
  - Ran the full live event and run-through in June 2026.
  - Tech: JavaScript, Web Serial, ESP-NOW, ESP32
  - Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A_dG05AvUfc
  - GitHub: https://github.com/akhileshkrbhagat1/RoboDominion

### Embedded & Linux

- **Linux Kernel Drivers** (C · ProcFS) — Loadable modules, ProcFS drivers and a Raspberry Pi GPIO LED driver.
  - Hello-world LKM, a ProcFS driver creating /proc/Kr_driver, and kernel → user-space data read by Python.
  - LED driver on Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W: on at insmod, off at rmmod, then controlled via procfs/sysfs.
  - Tech: C, Linux, ProcFS / sysfs
  - Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kCe2IH1ZpLQ
  - GitHub: https://github.com/akhileshkrbhagat1/linux_driver_devlopment
- **Raspberry Pi Pico, Bare-Metal** (Pico SDK) — RP2040 in C with the Pico SDK and CMake — no OS.
  - GPIO control, timing and low-level hardware interfacing without an operating system.
  - Tech: C, Pico SDK, CMake
  - Video: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/dJYTV-usOQY
- **Facial Recognition Lock** (Pi + ESP32) — Raspberry Pi recognises the face; an ESP32 drives the lock over UART.
  - OpenCV recognition on the Pi; GPIO actuation of the lock from ESP32 firmware.
  - Tech: Raspberry Pi, ESP32, UART
  - Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mzu6PfCb3Aw

### AI & Vision

- **HUX AI 2.0** (HIVE Lab) — A cap-mounted camera sees what the wearer sees while a second camera watches their face — a live AI rig for understanding human experience.
  - First-person camera on a cap streams the wearer's view; a face camera captures their reactions at the same time.
  - Built at HIVE Lab, IIT Kanpur, where I was a designer, researcher and engineer on the project.
  - Tech: Wearable camera, Computer vision, AI, HCI
  - Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EnDfHaJ_veg
- **RGB-D 3D Object Detection** (RealSense) — Detections placed in real 3D space using an Intel RealSense.
  - Synchronised colour + depth capture; detections combined with depth to estimate real-world positions.
  - Tech: Python, RealSense, OpenCV
  - Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z1wGa7aI8Yo
- **Neuro — LLM Assistant** (LLMs · MQTT) — Plain-language commands that run on your PC or on ESP32 devices.
  - Classifies each query and routes it to the right model or automation script.
  - Real-time lookup, task automation, image generation, and IoT control over MQTT.
  - Tech: Python, LLMs, MQTT, ESP32
  - Video: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/0bmbddCC9Mw
  - GitHub: https://github.com/akhileshkrbhagat1/Nuero_LLM
